description: This file defines the PurchaseOrder class extending CRMEntity, including methods for saving, retrieving activities, history, status history, report queries, relation management, and unrelation logic specific to PurchaseOrder in a CRM system.

classes.name: PurchaseOrder
classes.description: Represents a purchase order entity with methods for managing related activities, history, status, and relationships within the CRM system.

methods.name: PurchaseOrder
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves the purchase order module, updates product stock if needed, and updates currency info.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities related to the purchase order.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves activity history for the purchase order.

methods.name: get_postatushistory
methods.description: Retrieves status change history for the purchase order.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates secondary report query for related modules.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Unlinks a related entity from the purchase order.
